This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our software solutions and visit our website. Please note that WAGS Tech does not access, store, or use any personal or client-specific data that you process through our software. Your data is entirely under your control.

privacy.section1.li1.text: We may collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when you contact us for support or inquiries. This may include your name, email address, and phone number. However, we do not collect, access, or store any client-specific data processed by our software solutions.
privacy.section1.li2.text: We may collect certain technical information about your device and usage patterns when you visit our website. This includes data such as your IP address, browser type, and operating system. However, this information is limited to website visits and does not include any client or user data processed by our software solutions.

privacy.section2.li3: To gather usage statistics of our website solely to improve user experience.
privacy.section2.footer: WAGS Tech does not use any personal or client data processed through the software solutions for any other purposes.
privacy.section3.title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
privacy.section3.desc: WAGS Tech does not share, disclose, or sell any data processed through our software solutions, as we do not access or store this information. The limited information we collect (e.g., inquiries or support requests) is also not shared with any third parties, except in the following situations:
privacy.section3.li1: To comply with legal obligations or enforce our legal rights.
privacy.section3.li2: If necessary, to respond to legal processes or regulatory requests.
privacy.section4.title: Data Security

gr.head: AI Google Review integration, straight into Odoo
gr.blurb: WAGS connects your Google Business Profile to Odoo through the official Google API. Every review across every branch is synced, analysed by AI for sentiment and topic, and turned into dashboards your managers actually use.
gr.c1.d: You authorise WAGS from your own Google account on Google's consent screen. We request access to your Google Business Profile locations and reviews only — nothing else.
gr.c2.d: Ratings, review text, and existing replies are pulled through the Google Business Profile API and matched to the right branch inside your Odoo database.
gr.c3.d: Each review is scored for sentiment and tagged by topic — service, speed, product, price, cleanliness — in both Arabic and English.
gr.c4.d: Rating trends, response rate, and topic breakdowns sit next to your sales and POS data, per branch and per period.
gr.c5.d: Suggested replies are drafted in the reviewer's language. Your team reviews and approves every one before it is posted back to Google.
gr.c6.d: Review data is used only to run these features. It is never sold, never used for advertising, and you can revoke access at any time.
gr.note: WAGS reads Google review data only through the official Google Business Profile API, only after you approve the Google consent screen, and strictly in line with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements.
policy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
policy.lead: This page covers both the WAGS Tech privacy policy and our terms of service, including the disclosures required for our Google Business Profile review integration.
gapi.title: Google User Data & the Google Reviews Integration
gapi.desc: WAGS Tech offers an optional integration that brings your Google Business Profile reviews into your Odoo system for analytics. This section explains exactly what Google data we request, why we request it, and how it is handled. The integration is entirely optional and is never enabled without your explicit authorisation.
gapi.scopes.title: Access we request from Google
gapi.scopes.desc: When you connect the integration you are taken to Google's own consent screen, where you approve the following:
gapi.scopes.li1.text: read the business accounts and locations you manage, read the reviews left on those locations, and publish replies that your team has approved.
gapi.scopes.li2.text: the name and email address of the Google account granting access, used only to record who authorised the connection and to show it back to you in Odoo.
gapi.scopes.note: We do not request access to Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts, Photos, or any other Google service.
gapi.data.title: Data we access and store
gapi.data.li1: Business account and location details — location name, address, and the Google location identifier — so reviews can be matched to the correct branch.
gapi.data.li2: Reviews — star rating, review text, reviewer display name and profile photo URL, timestamps, and any reply already published.
gapi.data.li3: OAuth tokens issued by Google, stored encrypted at rest and used solely to call the Google Business Profile API on your behalf.
gapi.data.note: Synced review data is written into your own Odoo database. WAGS does not maintain a separate copy for its own purposes.
gapi.use.title: How we use this data
gapi.use.li1: Synchronising reviews into your Odoo system against the correct branch or location.
gapi.use.li2: Producing sentiment scores, topic tags, rating trends, and response-rate analytics on your dashboards.
gapi.use.li3: Drafting suggested replies that your team reviews and approves before anything is published back to Google.
gapi.use.note: Google user data is not used for any other purpose, and never for profiling individual reviewers.
gapi.limited.title: Limited Use disclosure
gapi.limited.desc: WAGS Tech's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Specifically:
gapi.limited.li1: We do not sell Google user data.
gapi.limited.li2: We do not use Google user data for advertising, and we do not transfer it to data brokers, information resellers, or advertising platforms.
gapi.limited.li3: Humans do not read Google user data, except with your explicit consent for a specific support request, for security or abuse investigations, to comply with applicable law, or where the data has been aggregated and anonymised.
gapi.limited.li4: Google user data is used only to provide and improve the review features described above, and is never used to train generalised AI or machine-learning models.
gapi.ai.title: AI processing of review content
gapi.ai.desc: Review text is processed by AI models to generate sentiment scores, topic tags, and reply drafts. This processing happens over encrypted connections, the content is not retained by the model provider for training, and the output is written back only to your own Odoo database.
gapi.retention.title: Retention, revocation, and deletion
gapi.retention.desc: Review data is retained while the integration is active. You can disconnect the integration at any time from your Odoo settings, or revoke WAGS Tech's access directly from your Google Account permissions page at
gapi.retention.desc2: When access is revoked or the integration is disconnected, we delete the stored OAuth tokens immediately. If you also want the synced review data erased, email us and we will complete the deletion within 30 days.
gapi.security.title: Security of Google data
gapi.security.desc: All traffic between WAGS, Google, and your Odoo instance runs over TLS. OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest, access to production systems is restricted to named engineers, and credentials are rotated when staff change.
